name: og-01-geology-to-reduced-carbon
title: The First Carbon
question: Can geological H2 drive CO2 reduction on vent mineral catalysts strongly enough to sustain a source of reduced organic carbon?
hypothesis: Over Fe/Ni/S surfaces and across the pH gradient, H2-driven CO2 reduction yields formate/acetate/pyruvate at lab-calibrated rates within a bounded (T,pH,H2,pressure) region; the Tutolo-2026 in-situ arm roughly halves the flux, and the feature-ablation controls (no gradient / no H2 / no catalyst) zero it.
objective: Add H2-driven CO2 reduction, reproduce the three benchmark experiments, and map the parameter region of sustained net organic-carbon flux.

findings.statement: The favorable arm reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy (formate 200 mM >> acetate 100 µM >> pyruvate 10 µM) at 100 °C.

evidence.observed: formate=200 mM, acetate=100 µM, pyruvate=10 µM

findings.explanation: Real eQuilibrator ΔG'-gated, lab-calibrated mineral kinetics over the pH gradient.

findings.statement: Formate is present with the pH-gradient proton-motive force and collapses to <1 mM in every control (no gradient / no H2 / no catalyst).
The Tutolo-2026 in-situ arm collapses the usable proton-motive gradient (pmf 427 → 43 mV), the discriminating test the campaign must survive.

evidence.observed: favorable pmf 427 mV vs Tutolo 43 mV

findings.explanation: Real FiPy Nernst-Planck electrodiffusion with a gradient_efficiency knob (1.0 favorable, 0.1 Tutolo).

findings.statement: Real eQuilibrator ΔG' is logged every step and makes feasibility explicit (fixation stops where ΔG' ≥ 0 — genuine product inhibition).

Carbon fixation SPENDS the proton gradient — a conserved proton budget (≈2 H⁺ per carbon) draws the loaded pmf down ~40% below the open-circuit 427 mV under load, then relaxes as products saturate. The gradient does work and is consumed, not merely correlated with reduction.

evidence.observed: pmf open-circuit 427 mV sags to ~250 mV (charge 0.60) at peak fixation, recovers to 427 mV

findings.explanation: A ProtonBudgetProcess integrates reservoir = supply − protons_per_carbon·carbon_flux − leak·reservoir; fixation reads the loaded pmf = pmf_open·(reservoir/capacity), closing the respiratory-control feedback.

findings.statement: A parameter sweep over the (vent pH × dissolved H₂) plane maps the carbon-fixation landscape, not a single run. In the open-flow reactor, sustained reduced-carbon throughput scales with both the pH gradient and H₂ (6.4 → 24 ×10⁻³ mol-C/s; steady pool 7–28 mM); the Tutolo-2026 gradient collapse roughly halves it on the same axes, and the no-gradient / no-catalyst / no-H₂ controls zero it. The favorable region is broadly productive — the sharp dependence is on a SUSTAINED gradient, not on sitting at one pH/H₂ point.
findings.explanation: 14×14 sweep of the real open-flow composite (pH 7–11 × H₂ 0.1–20 mM, exponential washout) reduced to sustained throughput per point; rendered as the carbon-fixation phase map (Decision view). Runner sims/compute_phase_grid.py.

conclusion: Reduced-carbon synthesis reproduces the lab benchmarks and maps a viable favorable regime, while the Tutolo-2026 arm identifies the in-situ gradient collapse that og-03+ must address. Feeds og-02 with pyruvate.

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the Preiner/Hudson organic-carbon benchmarks with the controls behaving correctly.

explanatory_gain.basis: Real thermodynamics (eQuilibrator) + electrochemistry (FiPy NPP) explain both the favorable regime and the Tutolo collapse.

limitations: Heterogeneous CO2-reduction kinetics are lab-calibrated (Preiner), not first-principles surface kinetics.

The phase map sweeps the (vent pH × H2) plane in the open-flow regime; T and pressure are still held fixed (facets, not yet swept), and the Tutolo axis is two efficiency levels rather than a continuous gradient_efficiency sweep.

resolved_uncertainties: A viable favorable regime exists; formate strictly requires the pH gradient + H2 + catalyst.

The (vent pH × H2) fixation landscape is now mapped (14×14 sweep, open-flow sustained throughput), not inferred from a single run — the favorable region is broadly productive and scales with both the gradient and H2.
remaining_uncertainties: The continuous gradient_efficiency threshold between the favorable and Tutolo-collapse regimes (the phase map shows two levels; a third axis would resolve the boundary).

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Extend the phase map with T and pressure facets and a continuous gradient_efficiency axis to locate the viable-fixation boundary.

implemented_methods: Module C — REAL FiPy Nernst-Planck: genuine finite-volume proton electrodiffusion across the Fe(Ni)S barrier (ocean->vent pH gradient) giving the proton-motive force, current density and diffusion potential. gradient_efficiency is the favorable (1.0) vs Tutolo-2026 in-situ-collapse (<<1) arm knob.

Module D (thermo) — REAL eQuilibrator: genuine component-contribution ΔG' (offline) for CO2+H2->formate/acetate/pyruvate, with the reaction-quotient term from live concentrations; a logistic feasibility gate makes energy_directionality explicit (fixation stops where ΔG' >= 0 — real product inhibition).

Module D (kinetics) — lab-calibrated heterogeneous CO2 reduction: rate = k · catalyst · feasible(ΔG') · drive(pmf) · avail(H2,CO2) · T-window · headroom, hitting the Preiner-2020 yield ceilings. Controls (no gradient / H2 / catalyst) zero it out; the Tutolo arm collapses the pmf drive.

canonical_runs.name: geology-to-reduced-carbon
canonical_runs.description: Real eQuilibrator+FiPy favorable run (auto-graded) + Tutolo arm + 3 controls (cross-run verdicts).

key_assumptions: Encode pH(T,P,ionic_strength), never laboratory pH as a constant environmental state.
expert_questions: RESOLVED: run BOTH arms — favorable (gradient_efficiency=1.0, canonical) and Tutolo-2026 (gradient_efficiency=0.1); the in-situ-ph-correction diagnostic compares them and flags the pmf collapse (427 -> 43 mV).

RESOLVED: thermodynamics via real eQuilibrator (offline component-contribution ΔG'), electrochemistry via real FiPy Nernst-Planck. (PHREEQC/Reaktoro speciation can be layered in later for the carbonate system; not required for the benchmarks.)
claim: Over Fe/Ni/S catalysts the model reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy - formate about 200 mM, acetate about 100 uM, pyruvate about 10 uM - and sustains net organic-carbon flux inside a bounded region set by the pH gradient and dissolved H2, while the no-gradient, no-H2 and no-catalyst controls collapse it. A discriminating in-situ arm (Tutolo-2026) shows the usable proton-motive gradient falling from 427 to 43 mV, roughly halving the sustained flux. Because the CO2-reduction kinetics are lab-calibrated to Preiner rather than derived from first-principles surface chemistry, this establishes a computational bridge from serpentinization to an organic-carbon feedstock, not yet metabolism.
